headline: Banks withstand all kinds of crises. How the Romanian banking system weathered the last decade and what comes next
summary: ZF describes the Romanian banking system as robust, resilient and well capitalised, with banks recovering quickly and posting historic highs on several fronts in recent years.
why: Bank capitalisation and profitability indicate the health of the financial system and its ability to fund the wider economy.
